notes: SLOT 14 (03:37 IST, 22:07 UTC) - WORK SLOT. Continued item 13 zero-fake-success onto the APPROVAL-RESOLUTION path, chosen because it is the surface a human reads to decide whether an external action actually ran. FOUND: /api/approvals/resolve in server.ts defaulted executionResult to { executed: true }, stamped status 'EXECUTED' with verificationStatus + finalTruthState both 'VERIFIED' unconditionally, and fell back to a SYNTHETIC result id 'urn:jarvis:executed:<request id>' when the executed branch produced none. So a request whose execution branch never ran, or whose provider returned no identifier, was written to the audit log and shown in the Permission Gateway as an executed + verified Level 4 action. FIX (commit 2769c31): new pure module src/utils/hardening/approvalResolution.ts exporting classifyApprovalOutcome(executionResult) which returns executed/outcome/evidenceRef/errorReason; VERIFIED only when a real provider URN (social post) or issue URL (GitHub issue) is present; UNVERIFIED when nothing confirmed; FAILED on a real provider error; the synthetic URN is never emitted. server.ts now updates action request status from resolution.executed (EXECUTED vs FAILED) and uses resolution.evidenceRef as resultUrn. src/components/PermissionGateway.tsx gained an explicit outcome === 'UNVERIFIED' branch that renders 'Not confirmed' and speaks that the action could not be confirmed, instead of the previous success toast.
